name: teamdynamix-mcp-server
description: Search and work with TeamDynamix tickets, assets, CIs, projects, issues and people, signed in as yourself.

base_url.title: TeamDynamix URL
base_url.description: Your organization's TeamDynamix address, e.g. https://yourorg.teamdynamix.com

expected_user.title: Your TeamDynamix email
expected_user.description: Pins sign-in to you, so a different account in the sign-in browser is refused. Optional.

default_app_id.title: Default ticketing application ID
default_app_id.description: Used when a request does not name an application. Optional; find IDs with the list applications tool.
